description: Phase 1 offline dependency inventory. Each item is something the Phase 1 workflow needs after installation; installDownload says whether installation fetches it. scripts/check-offline.mjs fails on a network origin missing from networkOrigins, an npm runtime package whose license is not in allowedLicenses, or a listed file whose bytes or SHA-256 changed. Terrain sources are in data/terrain/inventory.json. Nothing here is downloaded automatically.

networkOrigins.reason: The loopback bridge, local preview servers and Worker checks bind to the local machine only.
Default web origin the local launcher (TASK-151) accepts: the Vite development server reached at 127.0.0.1.
WebSocket connections to the loopback bridge, including the TASK-129 pause probe and the bridge each launcher run hosts.
Local preview server of scripts/probe-laptop.mjs.
Local preview server of scripts/check-gpu-perf.mjs.
Base URL for resolving relative material URLs and the local tiles-worker development binding.
Default Vite development origin accepted by the loopback bridge.
JSON Schema draft-07 $schema identifier; never fetched.
JSON Schema 2020-12 $schema identifier; never fetched.
Reserved .invalid $id of the Control Protocol v2 schema; never resolvable.
Internal Durable Object request URL inside the tiles worker; it never leaves the worker.
XML and SVG namespace identifiers inside bundled libraries; never fetched.
Pinned source clones for builds (ArduPilot, MAVLink definitions, Rapier, emsdk, JSBSim) and source citations; nothing is fetched at run time.
Pinned ArduPilot source files recorded with SHA-256 in native/ardupilot/source.lock.json for the TASK-045 build check.
The pinned parry3d-f64 0.31.1 crate archive that scripts/build-contact.mjs patches (TASK-095), checked against the SHA-256 in native/rapier/source.lock.json; only when Cargo's own cache lacks it.
ArduPilot documentation cited in tooling comments.
Citation of NASA TM X-3561 for the landing-gear drop fixture.
Citation of the NREL AirfoilPrep reference in the airfoil-input audit.
Citation of the forum topics the real flight logs of data/flight-logs/inventory.json come from; the logs are kept offline.
Source of the stored GPS almanac data/gnss/yuma-2444.alm, cited in packages/sensors/src/gps-almanac.ts (TASK-117); never fetched by MirageSITL.
Citation of the links the forum posts gave for the real flight logs of data/flight-logs/inventory.json; never fetched by MirageSITL.
Citation of the UIUC propeller and airfoil coordinate databases; the data were provided offline.
License URL recorded for ESA WorldCover (CC BY 4.0).
Dataset DOI recorded for ESA WorldCover.
Error-message links inside the bundled React production build.
Documentation link inside the bundled react-three-fiber build.
Shader credit comment inside a bundled three.js shader.
FABDEM V1-2 archives read only when an operator runs scripts/geodata/fetch_fabdem.py by hand.
EGM2008 geoid grid fetched only by the manual geodata environment setup (scripts/geodata/setup-wsl.sh).
.NET SDK installer for the 3D Tiles converters, fetched only by the manual geodata environment setup.
FLIR ADAS thermal sample fetched only by scripts/geodata/fetch_flir_sample.py after the operator accepts the dataset terms.
Datasheet citation of the TASK-143 IMU sensor preset.
Datasheet citation of the TASK-143 barometer sensor preset.
Datasheet citation of a TASK-143 magnetometer sensor preset.
Datasheet citation of the TASK-143 GNSS sensor preset.
Datasheet citation of the TASK-143 battery-monitor sensor preset.
FLIR ADAS dataset agreement page cited by the sample fetcher.
Link inside ArduPilot parameter descriptions (data/ardupilot/param-metadata.json, TASK-159); never fetched.
Link inside ArduPilot parameter descriptions (data/ardupilot/param-metadata.json, TASK-159); never fetched.
Link inside ArduPilot parameter descriptions (data/ardupilot/param-metadata.json, TASK-159); MirageSITL never fetches terrain from it.
Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles upstream of the optional tiles worker; needs keys and a deployment and is never an offline source.

items.item: MirageSITL web application, Workers and loopback bridge (apps/web, apps/bridge, packages/*)
items.source: This repository; npm run build produces apps/web/dist
items.license: Project-owned; the repository declares no license
items.notes: Built locally from the checkout. node scripts/check-offline.mjs --dist apps/web/dist checks the built bundle's network origins.

items.item: Runtime npm packages from package-lock.json (react, react-dom, three, @react-three/fiber, 3d-tiles-renderer, pmtiles, ws, zustand and their dependencies)
items.source: npm registry, through npm ci
items.license: MIT, ISC, BSD-3-Clause and Apache-2.0; scripts/check-offline.mjs checks every runtime package's declared license
items.neededFor: The web application bundle and the loopback bridge

items.item: Development npm packages (Vite, TypeScript, Vitest, Playwright, ESLint and their dependencies)
items.source: npm registry, through npm ci
items.license: Per package; build tools only, not shipped in the bundle
items.neededFor: Building the bundle and running the checks

items.item: Node.js
items.source: Node.js installer
items.neededFor: Build, local tooling, the loopback bridge and the local launcher (TASK-151)

items.item: Rust toolchain with the wasm32-unknown-unknown target
items.source: rustup
items.neededFor: Building the BET and contact WebAssembly artifacts

items.item: BET, propulsion and rigid-body WebAssembly (scalar and SIMD128) with manifest.json
items.version: Built from native/bet at the repository commit
items.source: node scripts/build-wasm.mjs writes packages/wasm-bet/dist (not tracked; its manifest records SHA-256 and bytes)
items.license: Project-owned; the crate has no external dependencies

items.item: Rapier contact WebAssembly with manifest.json
items.version: Rapier commit b716d375efc0201003f0cd9ef7168eee0b62c177 and parry3d-f64 0.31.1 with its storage-reuse patch (native/rapier/source.lock.json)
items.source: node scripts/build-contact.mjs clones the pinned Rapier source, takes the pinned parry crate archive from Cargo's cache or crates.io, fetches the other crates, then writes packages/physics/dist/contact (not tracked)
items.license: Apache-2.0 (Rapier, license SHA-256 pinned in the source lock; parry3d-f64)
items.neededFor: Basic contact on the synthetic pad and real terrain (TASK-187)

items.item: ArduPilot ArduCopter source for the external native SITL
items.version: ArduCopter V4.7.2, commit fb773567896014da007bca58358704d4a0d8516f (scripts/sitl.lock.json), decision D-01
items.source: https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot with its submodules
items.decision: D-01, decided on 2026-11-06, selects stable ArduCopter V4.7.2. D-02, decided on 2026-11-06: building on the user's Mac from the pinned source distributes nothing; shipping a prebuilt SITL binary carries GPL-3.0 source obligations and needs its own decision.

items.license: Apple developer tools and open-source Python packages, per tool

items.item: pymavlink telemetry sidecar and raw-wire auditors (scripts/sitl/*.py)
items.source: Python package index

items.item: MAVLink common and ardupilotmega message definitions behind packages/mavlink
items.source: https://github.com/mavlink/mavlink; the generated subset is in the repository

items.item: ArduPilot parameter metadata (names, ranges, units, descriptions)
items.source: Generated offline from the pinned ArduPilot checkout by its Tools/autotest/param_metadata/param_parse.py; no download beyond the source
items.decision: TASK-159 generated it from the pinned source and keeps it in the repository, so the parameter service and the Parameters tab read it offline; D-02 covers redistribution with any prebuilt firmware.
items.neededFor: The parameter service and the Parameters tab (TASK-159, TASK-160)

items.item: ArduPilot compass declination table
items.source: Generated offline from the pinned ArduPilot checkout; tables.cpp is itself generated from the IGRF; no download beyond the source
items.decision: TASK-172 generated it from the pinned source and keeps it in the repository, so a run's COMPASS_DEC comes from the table ArduPilot itself reads; D-02 covers redistribution with any prebuilt firmware.
items.neededFor: COMPASS_DEC at the boot of a run (TASK-172)

items.item: UAVLogViewer, patched and built locally for offline use
items.source: https://github.com/ArduPilot/UAVLogViewer with its parser submodule; dependencies from the npm registry (locked, plus @fortawesome/fontawesome-free 5.2.0 added by patch 0001); built by scripts/build-uavlogviewer.mjs
items.license: GPL-3.0 (LICENSE file); the build ships licenses/ with the GPL texts, the patches and every production npm package's notice
items.decision: D-04 decided by TASK-130 on 2026-10-28. TASK-179, TASK-180 and TASK-181 apply patches 0000-0004 and build the viewer reproducibly into the launcher home (digest in third_party/uavlogviewer/source.lock.json); the build opens DataFlash logs with no network request, in Google Chrome on the M5.

items.item: Google Chrome on macOS on Apple Silicon
items.source: Google
items.decision: D-08 (TASK-132): reference Macs, macOS and Chrome versions.

items.item: World Magnetic Model coefficients (WMM_2025.COF)

items.decision: Authenticity: the coefficients reproduce all 100 NOAA WMM2025 test values (tests/geomagnetic.test.ts, TASK-148).
